workflow: one already-swapped multi-sequence group KV restore
execution_kind: finite source-function and CPU-byte research replay; no native inference, request trace, GPU, FPGA, or measured timing

parameter_provenance.layers_hidden_heads_dtype: official complete model config fields at lines 14,19,20,23; includes every model layer/head, no layer truncation
parameter_provenance.tokens_per_block: research replay uses paper's explicit default 16 at pagedattention-2309.06180v1.txt:949-952; source CacheConfig accepts block_size
parameter_provenance.tensor_parallel_size: research choice of two workers to represent different head subsets; legal divisor 2 of 12, not a claim this model requires two GPUs
parameter_provenance.pool_slots: research choice 8/endpoint/worker; live unique slots=3, restore plus source reservation=3+2=5 <=8; no manufactured shortage
parameter_provenance.sequence_ids_tokens: research choices described below, not observed real requests/tokenization
parameter_provenance.packed_DDR_pools: adapter geometry choice: retain per-layer K/V tensor shapes and lay them consecutively in disjoint DDR allocations; not native torch physical layout
parameter_provenance.DID10_DID11: proposed bindings requiring platform-seat acceptance, not observed native GPU identities

group.owner: one trusted replay process owns both shards and all four pools
group.checkpoint_semantics: synthetic quiescent cached-prefix checkpoint assembled by a CPU producer proxy; cache state and block-manager transitions checked, no claim these tokens/KV came from native model execution or scheduler timing

physical_address_contract.source_and_destination_permissions: source DMA-readable, destination DMA-writable; ownership/cache transitions separately required
physical_address_contract.single_DMA: authorized: same trusted owner may map and issue both shards through one actual requester; no tenant-isolation restriction or requirement for independent DIDs

complete_restore_work.enumeration: worker in [0,1], layer in [0..11], component in [K,V], source_block in sorted [5,6,7]; destination from mapping; one full 12288B slot for each tuple
complete_restore_work.full_restoration_required: both K/V, all unique shared/tail slots, all 12 layers, all 12 global heads; no early-prefix completion substitute
complete_restore_work.ordinary_coalescing_allowed: source blocks 5,6 -> destination blocks 6,7 form one legal contiguous 24576B run; block7->5 remains 12288B; 96 such ordinary descriptors total if no other adapter constraint; batching/scatter and whole-task single-DMA remain allowed

prior_swapout.eventual_source_readiness_requires: complete prior swapout and cache ownership handoff

COW.reason: 16-token shared prefix block is full; divergent token starts a new unshared tail block per sequence. Source append_slot takes allocate-new-block branch, no shared-tail COW

prior_and_other_work.initialization_producer_and_verification: count all pool fill/producer stores, prior copy, full restored CPU reads/checks, descriptor/metadata and ownership/drain separately; no timing supplied
prior_and_other_work.weights_activation_model_execution: not allocated/executed in research replay; native application cost is outside this byte replay and cannot be claimed covered

producer_proxy.implementation: CPU deterministic finite fp16 bit-pattern initializer, not LLM numerical computation
producer_proxy.valid_word_recipe: uint16 bits = (0x0400 + (((layer*2+component_index)*6*3*16*64 + local_head*3*16*64 + semantic_index*16*64 + token*64 + dimension) % 0x77ff)) | (worker<<15); component K=0,V=1; positive shard0/negative shard1 finite nonzero fp16 codes
producer_proxy.live_slot_padding_byte: 0xA0+4*worker+semantic_index; padding is copied and checked but not semantic useful KV

dependencies_and_lifetime.source_native_safety: block refcounts and shared deduplication; same cache stream orders full copies; event per layer recorded after K/V; attention waits before cache overwrite/decode use
frozen_restore_dependencies: producer proxy -> complete prior swapout -> source immutability/cache handoff -> frozen full mapping -> eligible restore issue
all six slot copies of worker/layer actually complete -> completion ID confirmed -> destination CPU ownership -> consumer proxy reads/checks that layer
both worker/layer checks -> joint layer-data-ready bookkeeping marker; not attention start/token completion
all 144 full jobs and all 24 worker/layer checks -> final drain/no outstanding -> finite replay success -> logical release
physical unmap/free only after drain/ownership checks; source logical refcount-free is not hardware completion or unmapping
dependencies_and_lifetime.future_hardware_event_evidence: Reuse stage106 JOB_EVENTS identities and true NEXT_ID/DONE binding, adapt dynamic count/bytes; numeric cycles/IDs must come from actual run and are absent here
dependencies_and_lifetime.consumer_proxy: CPU full byte verification including padding, source preservation and unused slots; no attention arithmetic/all-reduce/token output
dependencies_and_lifetime.natural_termination: finite enumeration exhausted, every complete byte verified, every outstanding transfer drained; no fabricated EOS, arrival, deadline or compute delay
dependencies_and_lifetime.pool_mapping_lifetime: backing and mapping may be prepared at replay setup and persist until final drain; freeing logical slot IDs does not revoke a pool mapping
dependencies_and_lifetime.source_logical_free: swap_out/swap_in can free old slot IDs while building the dictionary before physical copy. Static check records that boundary; it never equates it with completed DMA

actual requester DID identity/shared translation path and hardware resource mode
